Description EN: Test how force changes movement: push a toy car on carpet, tile, paper, and towel. Predict, test, compare. Grade 4 twist: explain how gravity or magnetism could change the movement.

Description EN: Draw the water cycle or layers of Earth's surface. Add 4 labels and explain it aloud in French or English. Grade 4 twist: name one human choice that protects land, air, water, or organisms.

Description EN: Draw Alberta. Add Rockies, prairies, one city, one natural resource, one official symbol, and one First Nations, Metis, or francophone contribution. Grade 4 twist: connect Alberta to early Canada, New France, or Confederation.
